skills.name: brag-sheet
skills.description: Turn vague "what did I do?" into evidence-backed impact statements for performance reviews, self-reviews, promotion packets, and weekly updates. Uniquely mines Copilot CLI session logs to reconstruct forgotten work, plus git commits and GitHub PRs. Enforces a 3-part impact contract (action → result → evidence). Works standalone with zero dependencies. Trigger for: "brag", "log work", "what did I do", "backfill my work history", "performance review", "self-review", "self assessment", "write impact statement", "review prep", "promo packet", "promotion case", "weekly update", "status report", "accomplishments", "what did I ship", "I forgot to log my work", "summarize my work", "track my wins", "what should I highlight", "end of half", "career growth", "work journal", or any request to document, summarize, or organize work accomplishments.

review.why: Turns real work history from git and PRs into evidence-backed impact statements for reviews and resume bullets.
review.summary: Writes impact statements in an action, result, evidence format for self-reviews, promotion packets and weekly updates. It can reconstruct past work from git commits, GitHub PRs and Copilot CLI session logs, and asks before saving.
strengths: Confirms scope and shows drafts before saving
cautions: Aimed at performance reviews more than job applications
Best value needs git, gh or Copilot logs

notes: Reads local session logs, git history and GitHub PRs, which are personal work data
May run git and gh commands
